question: Whom must the practitioner honor before proceeding while holding the ritual vessel?
premises: The direction-lords are to be honored
The birds are also to be honored
The practitioner holds a vessel in hand
inference: Having bowed to the direction-lords and the birds, one proceeds holding the vessel in hand.
uncertainties: The identity of khagān in this ritual context is not fully specified
plain_english: Having bowed to the lords of the directions and the birds, holding the vessel in hand.
